output_list.vulnerability: Initializing Storage Variable Out of Constructor
output_list.reason: The mint function allows the owner to mint new tokens and assign them to any address. This can be problematic if an attacker tricks the owner into calling this function with a malicious contract as the _owner, causing the attacker to gain control over the minted tokens.
The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The increase in ownership balance is not checked for overflow, allowing users to mint an unlimited amount of tokens.
The mintBatch function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The increase in ownership balance is not checked for overflow, allowing users to mint an unlimited amount of tokens.
The buyPack function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The increase in ownership balance is not checked for overflow, allowing users to buy an unlimited amount of packs.
The submitStack function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The increase in ownership balance is not checked for overflow, allowing users to submit an unlimited amount of stacks.
